title: How to restart the service on watch
symptom: After turning off and on the watch, xDrip does not work as a standalone collector; the user cannot restart the service, and the only workaround is to disable and re-enable the smartwatch from the phone used for configuration, but the user does not have that phone available.
evidence_quote: I'm not able to re-start the service, I tried every option. The only way is to disable and re-enable the smartwatch from xdrip installed on the phone I used to configure it.
